findings.title: Transient check failure cached as core off
findings.problem: The except branch in _compute returns (False, None, ...) and the result is memoized by @cache, so one transient exception (config not loaded, import error) disables core for the process lifetime.
findings.impact: Core routes stay unmounted or 404 until restart after a one-off early failure. Reachability of a transient failure was not confirmed.
findings.recommendation: Do not cache failures: clear the cache in the except branch, or compute outside @cache and only memoize successful results.
findings.check_notes: core_availability catches outside @cache; _compute no longer catches; test_failure_is_not_cached exists

fix.change: _compute no longer catches; core_availability catches outside @cache so failures are not memoized

findings.title: require_core ignores STANDALONE setting
findings.problem: require_core calls core_availability(config) unconditionally. The docstring and spec say the check is only called when STANDALONE is on, and core is always on otherwise. Verified in source: no STANDALONE guard.
findings.impact: Non-standalone deployments with no static provider settings (stored credentials, SaaS) get 404 on ide inference, user reactions, final_feedback and admin conversation routes. Breaks AC1 and AC2 and public endpoints.
findings.recommendation: Return early when not config.STANDALONE (e.g. `if config.STANDALONE and not core_availability(config)[0]: raise HTTPException(404, 'Not found')`) and add a test with STANDALONE off and no provider.
findings.check_notes: require_core checks config.STANDALONE first; noop test exists

findings.title: Core gating concern added to oversized main.py
findings.problem: CORE_ROUTERS, register_core_routers and _log_core_gating are appended to a ~1970-line main.py; code-quality.md Module Cohesion requires a dedicated module.
findings.impact: Documented code-quality standard only partially met; blocks the workflow per standards review.
findings.recommendation: Move CORE_ROUTERS, register_core_routers and _log_core_gating to a new module and import them in main.py.

fix.change: moved CORE_ROUTERS, register_core_routers, log_core_gating to rest_api/core_gating.py

findings.title: Route inventory incomplete for two routers
findings.problem: Spec requires admin, background_tasks and agent_workspace to be inventoried with per-route verdicts. Only admin is gated; no change or recorded verdict for background_tasks or agent_workspace. Edge lens also notes other always-mounted LLM-backed routers (tool, files, workflow generator) are ungated.
findings.impact: Core-reaching routes may return 5xx instead of 404 when core is off. Reachability unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Grep background_tasks and agent_workspace for core-reaching routes, gate them with Depends(require_core) or record a not-gated verdict; also confirm other LLM-backed routers.
findings.check_notes: core_gating docstring records not-gated verdicts for background_tasks and agent_workspace

fix.change: inventoried background_tasks and agent_workspace: no LLM path, verdict not-gated recorded in core_gating docstring

findings.title: Main-mount test sets no Azure profile

findings.impact: The spec'd regression test (valid profile mounts core) does not guard the behavior.
findings.recommendation: Set STANDALONE and a valid Azure profile, reimport main, assert core routes are mounted.
